objective.text: Select a configured mailer without changing the application's global default.

difficulty.rationale: Route this message through the intended configured transport while leaving shared defaults intact.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Two mailers are configured: default and transactional. One receipt must use transactional without changing the application’s default mailer for subsequent messages. Which call selects it explicitly?
